cases.action: Leave the due date unspecified for that task and observe its resulting state.
cases.expected: The task remains without any assigned date value; this is a permitted state and a due date is not required. No clearing of an existing date is involved.
cases.preconditions: An existing task has no assigned due date.

cases.action: Assign the selected future date to the identified task using the available user-facing operation.
cases.expected: That task has the assigned date, with day, month and year exactly matching the user selection, rather than remaining undated. Parameterize applicable future calendar boundaries without imposing a business date range.
cases.preconditions: An existing task has no assigned date; the user selects a known future calendar date.

cases.action: Assign the selected future date to the first task; leave the second task unspecified.
cases.expected: The identified first task records the exact selected calendar date. The second task remains without an assigned date, combining the two approved outcomes without requiring creation or date clearing.
cases.preconditions: Two identifiable existing tasks are undated, and a known future date is selected for the first task only.

cases.action: Document the past-date scenario as blocked; do not execute it as a product pass/fail acceptance assertion.
cases.expected: No approved expected product outcome exists. Neither acceptance nor rejection may be asserted until the deferred business decision and renewed authority are supplied.
cases.preconditions: A task and a valid past calendar date are available; U-001/AQ-001 remain deferred.

cases.action: Document changing or clearing the assigned date as undefined; do not automate either as an accepted functional capability.
cases.expected: No approved outcome for changing or clearing exists. Do not infer either capability or its prohibition; keep this case blocked pending explicit upstream definition and approval.
cases.preconditions: A task already has an assigned due date; AQ-002 remains open.
